QuestionStmt.S: In the following circuit shown in figure, three diodes are connected each with forward resistance $40\Omega$ and infinite backward resistance. The current through $100\Omega$ resistance is

Solution.S:
From the figure diode $D_2$ and $D_3$ are forward biased while $D_1$ is reverse biased.

Hence current will pass through $D_2$ and $D_3$ only.

$D_2$ and $D_3$ each have forward resistance $40\Omega$

Total resistance in the circuit

$$R = \frac{200 \times 100}{300} + 100 = \frac{500}{3}$$

$$I = \frac{V}{R} = \frac{6}{\frac{500}{3}} = \frac{18}{500} = 0.036 \text{ A} = 36 \text{ mA}$$
